# Finance and accounting

<!-- Generated by scripts/package/render_roles.py. Edit the YAML source, not this file. -->

**Department id:** `finance`  
**Mission:** Keep the company solvent and honest about its numbers with ranged assumptions and professional review.

## Startup stage

Founder plus an external accountant. The financial model lives in a spreadsheet with visible formulas; the approval matrix is one page.

## Agents operating in this department

`financial-modeler`, `business-model-auditor`, `cfo-finance`, `operations-analyst`

## Roles

### Financial planning and analysis

Role id: `financial-planning-analyst`

| Field | Definition |
|---|---|
| Mission | Build and maintain the operating model, scenarios and variance analysis. |
| Scope of responsibility | Budget, forecast, scenarios, unit economics, variance. |
| Core activities | Build bottom-up budget; Model scenarios and sensitivity; Compare actuals; Explain variance |
| Inputs | Plans; Actuals; Pricing; Usage |
| Outputs and deliverables | Operating model; Scenario analysis; Variance reports |
| Decisions it can make | Model structure |
| Decisions requiring approval | Budget approval by CFO/CEO |
| Collaborating roles | strategy; operations; product |
| Reporting relationship | cfo |
| KPIs | Forecast accuracy; Runway visibility |
| Quality expectations | Ranges and sources per input; variable AI/cloud costs included |
| Tools and resources | Financial model template |
| Common failure modes | False precision; Single scenario |
| Appropriate AI autonomy | propose |
| Human approval requirements | Budget |
